name: Captain William Wells, come from Fort Wayne with a Miami escort
head: wells_william

present_on_scene_date.note: He reached the post on 12, 13 or 14 August depending on the source (native.json); every account has him there for the evacuation.

not_in_this_household.note: His Miami escort of about thirty men is named by no source; T-3467 gives them reconstructed cards when it places them.

persons.name: William Wells

present_on_scene_date.note: Presence on the afternoon of 14 August 1812, read from the evidence below; no source takes a roll call that afternoon.

also_written: Ep-i-con-yare (what the Indians called a Wells, per the Heald family)
persons.note: Rebekah Heald's uncle, Indian agent and interpreter at Fort Wayne. Indian agent/interpreter from Fort Wayne leading the Miami escort; uncle of Rebekah Heald. Kentucky-born, adopted by the Miami; son-in-law of Little Turtle. Arrived 13 Aug (Heald 1812), 12 Aug (Helm 1814), or 14 Aug (Wau-Bun). Heald's dating preferred. 15 and 16 August: Led the advance with blackened face; killed; heart eaten (Quaife). Afterwards: Killed 15 Aug 1812.

evidence.quote: On the 13th, Captain Wells, of Fort Wayne, arrived with about 30 Miamies, for the purpose of escorting us in
evidence.claim: Arrival with about 30 Miamis on the 13th
evidence.tier: contemporary (written 1812-1815 by a participant or from participants)

evidence.quote: Capt. William Wells arrived from Fort Wayne on the 12th August with 27 Miamis
evidence.tier: contemporary (written 1812-1815 by a participant or from participants)

evidence.quote: the arrival, on the 14th of August, of Captain Wells[33] with fifteen friendly Miamis.
evidence.tier: Kinzie family tradition (Wau-Bun; pamphlet 1836/1844, book 1856; Quaife App. II judges its speeches and dialogue invented)

evidence.locator: Appendix V (Darius Heald to Draper, 1868), lines 16395-16396
evidence.quote: readily recognized him, though painted black & dressed like an Indian

evidence.quote: the Indians charged her with being an _Ep-i-con-yare--a_ Wells.
